rule_commit: da7b3b10bc (template_reader.py rule, READER_VERSION irpt-template-reader.r18.1, READER_PINS digest 0c9326f4d3ba6dea9aee6f813328b865768ec6f872171adae0e78c01a4a8da75). The negative controls were committed alone at 015af53b8f, before the rule.
rule: A row-1 header cell in column C or beyond IS an account header when its words -- case-folded, split on whitespace, hyphen and slash, each stripped of punctuation -- are: (a) either the words 'no. of' followed by an account word that is NOT plural, or an optional modifier (custodian, client, sub, brokerage, ira, joint); then (b) an account word (account, accounts, acct, accts, acc, subaccount); then nothing, or identifier words only (number, numb, num, nbr, no, id, ref, reference, code, key, identifier, seq, sequence). A whole-cell exclusion list is applied first: the six attribute forms of the r17 record and the new COUNT exclusion (no. of + plural account word).
where_in_code: infra/aws/lambda/investor-reporting/intake/template_reader.py: _header_words, _is_account_header, ACCOUNT_WORDS, ACCOUNT_MODIFIERS, ACCOUNT_TAIL_WORDS, COUNT_PLURAL_WORDS, ACCOUNT_HEADER_EXCLUDED; used by _several_accounts
domain: row-1 header cells in columns C and beyond (A and B are the ticker and unit headers); the column counts only when it holds 2 or more distinct non-empty values in the rows below it. Declared grid for the subtraction below: 10 prefixes (none, custodian, client, sub, brokerage, ira, joint, no. of, trust, fund) x 10 account spellings (account, accounts, acct, accts, acc, accnt, subaccount, subaccounts, sub-account, accounting) x 22 tail words (none, number, numbers, no, num, nbr, numb, id, ref, reference, code, key, identifier, seq, sequence, serial, seqno, nos, holder, count, type, value), each joined with single spaces: 2200 distinct headers.
population: constructed and synthetic (no real-use account header is in the repository, as the r13, r16 and r17 records state). The population is ACCOUNT_HEADER_POPULATION.json in this folder: 28 identifier forms (the r17 seeds, the six new forms and the round-16 forms), 2 count forms, 10 attribute forms, 7 non-account forms, and 6 word negative controls committed before the change. Denominator 53 forms.

additions.form_admitted: Brokerage Account, Brokerage-Account, Brokerage Acct No.
additions.why_it_names_an_account: Brokerage Account names the account a holder owns, as Custodian Account and Client Account do; the word names whose account it is, not an attribute of it.

additions.form_admitted: IRA Account, IRA-Account, IRA Account No
additions.why_it_names_an_account: IRA Account names the registered account a holder owns, as Brokerage Account does; the account word carries the identity and the modifier names the registration. IRA alone, or IRA Account Type, stays unmatched: the account TYPE header is on the exclusion list.

additions.form_admitted: Joint Account, Joint Acct No, Joint/Account
additions.why_it_names_an_account: Joint Account names the one account held by several holders, as a custodian or client account is one account; the word names the holding, not who holds it (Joint Holder Name stays unmatched: holder is not an account word).

one word for the account a sub-account is; Sub-Account already matches through the sub modifier, so the one-word spelling names the same account. subaccounts (plural) is NOT added: no census form carries it, and the cell admits it only if justified.

additions.form_admitted: Account Seq, Account Seq No, Client Account Seq
additions.why_it_names_an_account: Account Seq numbers the account within the file, as num and number already do for Account Num and Account Number; a sequence number is an identifier tail, not an attribute of the account.

additions.form_admitted: Account Sequence, Account Sequence No, Client Account Sequence
additions.why_it_names_an_account: the spelled-out form of seq, the same identifier tail.

additions.word: No. of Accounts (and any no. of + plural account word)
additions.form_excluded: No. of Accounts, NO. OF ACCOUNTS, no of accts
additions.why_excluded: the header names a count of the accounts a file holds (one number for the file), not an identifier of which account a row belongs to. A distinct-value check over it would turn back a column that names no account. Keyed on the words alone; see S32 for the residual where a real identifier column carries this header.
additions.singular_control: No. of Account still matches (not in the plural exclusion): 'No. of Account' is in identifier_forms and is turned back

exclusions.why: names the kind of account (taxable, IRA, trust). Two kinds are not two accounts. Carried from r17 unchanged.
a label for an account; joint holders or a nickname can be written several ways in one account. Carried from r17 unchanged.
names who holds the account; a joint holder list can name several people in one account. Carried from r17 unchanged.
names who manages the account; a team can hold several names in one account. Carried from r17 unchanged.
a money value; it differs on almost every row. Carried from r17 unchanged.
whether the account is open or closed; a state, not an account number. Carried from r17 unchanged.
the date the account was opened; a date, not an account number. Carried from r17 unchanged.
see the COUNT exclusion above. New in AR-y-181.

negative_controls.why_each_is_not_an_account_column: a fee, a contribution, a holder name, a trade sequence number and a fee on a subaccount name a column that is not the account a row belongs to; each carries the new word and fails the rule on its head word (the first word after any modifier is not an account word) or on a non-identifier tail word.
